name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: REINIT-CERTVERIFIER-EXPERIMENT BUILD (v3, fixes a logging bug that silently disabled the reinit entirely), not for production: 0.4.32's timestamp helper used `performance.now()`, which throws ReferenceError in this privileged script's scope (not a Window/Worker global here) -- confirmed via a real console-export log that this crashed reinitCertVerifier() on its very first line, before its own try/catch, on every single occurrence in an entire test session, meaning the enterprise-roots pref toggle never actually ran even once despite what looked like an improved self-heal pattern that session (attributable to something else -- most likely test-sequence luck around send-before-read timing, not this mechanism). Switches the timestamp helper to Date.now(). This is the first build where reinitCertVerifier()'s actual effect (if any) can be validly tested.
